subject.name_or_desc: 2020 United States presidential election and its aftermath

context.question: Who will win the 2020 US election, who will actually take the presidency, and what follows for the country?
context.setting: Democrat Joe Biden leads incumbent Republican President Donald Trump in most polls on the eve of the 3 November 2020 election. The campaign has been marked by disputes over mail-in voting and warnings that the loser may not accept the result.
